description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity class for the OrangeHRM HRM system. It models the data structure and ORM mappings for employee termination records, including properties such as termination date, notes, reason, and associated employee.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationRecord
classes.description: Entity class representing a record of employee termination, including termination date, notes, reason, and employee association.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the termination record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the termination record.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves any notes associated with the termination.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets notes related to the termination.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with this termination record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this termination record.
